relations.support_notes: (ID:5412), 44b1-4: 'di ni byams dpal chos grags bzang pos sor mo'i dpal las 'khrungs pa'o || 'di bris dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro kun gyis || dge ba gang bsags phyogs cig sdom byas nas || dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs su zhal bzhes pa'i || spyan sngar phul bas thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig || bdag kyang skyes zhing tshe rabs thams cad du || de la 'byor thob cing bzhon nu rab byung nas || dam pa khyed dang 'dra bas rjes su rab bzung nas || nges 'byung tshul khrims snor 'gyod dri med cing || rang nyid zhi bde don du mi gnyer cing || 'gro kun don du bde stong thob gyur cig || bdag gi bla ma rje btsun chos rje de || dga' ldan gnas sam bde ba spyan lasogs || dag pa'i zhing khams gang na bzhugs kyang rung || bdag kyang 'khor gyi thog mar skye gyur cig ||
